solver.method: One damped Gauss-Newton trajectory; four finite-difference columns, bounded step, maximum six backtracks. No grid/restarts. Source-area weighted degree-two quadrature to closest finite saddle top; actual context penetration and socket residual penalties. Exact bilateral finite-area gates are independent of objective.

limits: Source preparation only until parent CPU2 run. No existing runtime or player file changes.
Unaccepted numerical candidate is not seated appearance acceptance. Parent must play original fully dressed selected rider on both bikes.
Geometry diagnostics are local and sampled; no cloth force, continuous collision, whole-character intersection, or global material proof.

Fixed palms use the pinned current driver target frames; soles use measured calibration03 frames, common to both pinned bikes. Their actual glove/bar and sole/peg area contact remains separately unqualified.
Carrier search quadrant is an authored forward-to-upright Garage restriction, not a measured anatomical range. Flex uses existing 20-degree driver envelope. No skeleton scale or length changes.
Breathing center and both extrema are checked for support/socket area only; full neighboring intersections are checked at authored center. Moving validation remains required.
Positive majority-area gates, 1 mm fit band, strict centroid interiors and bilateral center are proposed authoring proxies, not physical contact or art acceptance.
Images are omitted in memory by existing CPU loader; disk geometry, materials, textures and source identity are not replaced.

Each posed core must retain downward projected area at least half its actual 3D surface area; this additional authoring proxy rejects nearly vertical sliver contact. It is an orientation proxy, not a measured force threshold.
